description: 10 1/2% 8-year note issued 1983-05-16 due 1991-05-15, reopened 1983-08-15 at 10.53%: settlement inside a short first coupon, r = 92, s = 184, r' = 183.

reference.version: 31 CFR 356 App. B, current eCFR text as of 2026-10-26
reference.convention: Treasury non-indexed note/bond: actual/actual (ICMA-equivalent) semi-annual accrual; price per 100 rounded to six places; fractional first period discounted at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]
reference.source: 31 CFR Part 356, Appendix B, Section II (via law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356), Section II.F

_pricing.reason: Treasury formula discounts the fractional first period at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]; the library's street yield compounds it [(1 + i/2)^(r/s)]. Verified: substituting the simple-interest factor into the library's own cash flows reproduces the printed price to the 6th decimal.

_stub_fraction.reason: Street fraction of a stub period divides by the stub's own length, not the regular reference period s (#60; see quantlib_eur_icma_semiannual_settled_inside_short_first_coupon).
